game.title: Degor (Stone Throwing)
game.description: A traditional game where competitors throw flat stones across a river or open field, competing for distance and accuracy. Similar to discus throwing but using natural river stones.
howToPlay: Step 1: Players search for flat smooth stones along riverbeds.
Step 2: A throwing line is marked on the ground.
Step 3: Players take turns throwing their stones using a spinning motion.
Step 4: Distance is measured from the throwing line to where the stone lands.
Step 5: In river versions, players throw stones to the opposite bank.
Step 6: Accuracy can be tested by aiming at specific targets.
Step 7: Stones that skip on water are admired for technique.
Step 8: The farthest throw wins the round.
Step 9: Players develop strength and throwing mechanics through practice.
Step 10: Winners may receive simple prizes or bragging rights.
